runs.name: c12f-late
runs.description: step C12f: the dark Deep vents preset; at 5 min (the founders nearly gone, the food ring formed) 150 cells of one hand-made genome (a founder eater whose engines are set to g + T -> gT at rate 2 and G + T -> GT at 1.5: a test, not a rule) placed on rings 12-20 R round the vents; 30 min

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(), R = moire.cells.R, m = Math.min(v.cssW, v.cssH), pts = []; for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const a = (-90 + 120 * k) * Math.PI / 180, cx = v.cssW / 2 + Math.cos(a) * 0.27 * m, cy = v.cssH / 2 + Math.sin(a) * 0.27 * m; for (let j = 0; j < 50; j++) { const b = 2 * Math.PI * j / 50, r = (12 + 8 * ((j * 7) % 5) / 4) * R; pts.push([cx + Math.cos(b) * r, cy + Math.sin(b) * r]); } } const { founderGenome } = await import('/src/genome.js'); const g = founderGenome('burn'); g[32] = 12; g[36] = 2; g[33] = 14; g[37] = 1.5; g[38] = 0; return await moire.app.place(pts, g)
